moments.window: Tailless means the last letter goes leaving eek. Lake is shortened to L as on maps. Circled by puts L inside eek. That gives eagle. A large bird of prey with keen eyesight and a powerful hooked beak. Four across. Feeling wicked cutting off nearly everyone. Wicked is slang for sensational both meaning brilliant. Everyone means all and nearly gives just its first two letters. A and L. Cutting off removes those letters from the end of sensational that gives sensation. A physical feeling or a state of great public excitement and interest. Nine across. Leading dance in hospital department. Dance means prom a formal school dance

entry.clue: Lake circled by hungry tailless bird

moments.window: stealing, taking someone's property without permission. Four down. Hired [snorts] guard seen occasionally felt bitter. Hired means rented. Occasionally means taking every other letter. Alternate letters of seen give C. God's is a container signal. So, rented holds a C inside. That gives resented. Felt bitter or aggrieved about something regarded as unfair. Five down. State what to say at the altar about a husband. What to say at the altar is I do, the wedding vow. A stands as itself. Husband is shortened to H. About is a container signal. So, I do wraps around A and H. That gives Idaho. A state in the Northwestern United States famous for growing potatoes. Seven down.

entry.clue: Hired guards seen occasionally felt bitter

moments.window: of a British and duty are all rearranged together. That gives birthday suit bare skin since being in your birthday suit means wearing nothing at all. 23 across. Part of company that's failing. Part of means in since a part of something is in it. Company means firm since a firm is a business company that gives the infirm. Weak or frail especially through old age or illness. 24 across. Privy. You once dumped in river. You once means thou. The old English word for you river means the name of a river in Yorkshire. Dumpton puts thou inside that gives out an outdoor lavatory or a small building set apart from the main house. 25 across.
